field.name: il_tax_rate
field.comment: Illinois flat income tax rate 4.95% (2025). Unchanged since 2017. 35 ILCS 5/201(b). Source: Illinois Department of Revenue https://tax.illinois.gov/research/taxrates/income.html

field.name: il_personal_exemption
field.comment: Illinois personal exemption amount $2,850 (2025). Source: IL-1040 Instructions, Illinois Department of Revenue

field.name: il_uses_federal_taxable
field.comment: Illinois uses federal adjusted gross income as starting point, with specific additions and subtractions per 35 ILCS 5/203(b)(1). Illinois does not have a state standard deduction.

field.name: il_military_retirement_exclusion
field.comment: Illinois military retirement exclusion amount (computed). 100% of military retirement pay is exempt from Illinois income tax per 35 ILCS 5/203(a)(2)(K). No age limits, no dollar caps. MOAA State Report Card: Grade A. Source: https://turbotax.intuit.com/tax-tips/military/states-that-dont-tax-military-retirement/

field.name: il_sbp_exclusion
field.comment: Illinois Survivor Benefit Plan (SBP) exclusion (computed). 100% of SBP payments exempt per 35 ILCS 5/203(a)(2)(K). Illinois does not tax pension income. MOAA Grade A

field.name: il_total_military_exclusion
field.comment: Total Illinois military income exclusion (computed). Sum of military retirement and SBP exclusions. Illinois is one of 28 states that don't tax military retirement benefits.

field.name: il_msrra_compliant
field.comment: Illinois honors MSRRA (Military Spouses Residency Relief Act). Military spouse income is exempt if spouse maintains different domicile. Federal law compliance.

field.name: il_scra_compliant
field.comment: Illinois honors SCRA (Servicemembers Civil Relief Act). Active duty military pay is exempt if service member maintains different state of residence. Federal law compliance.

field.name: il_adjusted_agi
field.comment: Illinois AGI after military exclusions (computed from federal AGI). Base for Illinois tax calculation after subtractions per 35 ILCS 5/203

field.name: il_taxable_income
field.comment: Illinois taxable income (computed). Federal AGI minus military exclusions and other subtractions, plus any additions. Used as base for applying 4.95% flat rate.

field.name: state_tax_liability
field.comment: Illinois state tax liability (computed). IL taxable income × 4.95% flat rate per 35 ILCS 5/201(b)
